# Ricardo Meza

> AI Product Engineer and Product Lead based in Mexico City. I use AI to solve problems, improve user experiences and automate workflows, and have many years of experience across frontend architecture, full-stack development, and team leadership.

Currently on the Labs Team at Clara — Latin America's leading corporate payments platform — where I design and ship full-stack AI tools from 0 to 1. I work across React/Next.js on the frontend and Python/Node.js + OpenShift microservices on the backend.

Before specializing in AI product development I served as Frontend Architect at Conekta, senior engineer at Rappi and MetaMap, and spent 4 years with Mozilla Foundation and Mozilla México — as Main Manager for Mozilla México I led localization of Firefox into Mexican Spanish and indigenous languages.

## This site

ricardomeza.com is an interactive portfolio with a 3D particle system and a Unix-style terminal emulator. Type `about me` or `help` in the terminal to explore.
